business.name: Celsius Dessert Bar
business.tagline: Sydney's premier liquid nitrogen gelato experience
business.about_text: Celsius Dessert Bar brings theatre and indulgence together. From our Chatswood kiosk to weddings, corporate launches, and Sydney's biggest events, we craft small-batch liquid nitrogen gelato live in front of your guests — every scoop made fresh, every flavour built to order. We've been the dessert moment behind brand activations, gala dinners, premieres, and private celebrations across the city.

address.street: Kiosk 4, Chatswood Bus Interchange, 436 Victoria Avenue

highlights: 2 signature flavours plus a custom flavour designed for your event

menu.note: Placeholder menu — client to supply final flavour list.

signature.name: Vanilla Bean
signature.description: Single-origin vanilla steeped into fresh cream, frozen in seconds so none of the perfume escapes.

signature.name: Dark Chocolate
signature.description: 70% couverture folded through at -196°C — closer to frozen ganache than gelato.

signature.name: Salted Caramel Pretzel
signature.description: Burnt-sugar caramel, Murray River salt flakes, shards of dark-roasted pretzel.

signature.name: Strawberries & Cream
signature.description: Whole macerated strawberries swirled through sweet cream, plated in nitrogen fog.

signature.name: Pistachio & Honey
signature.description: Sicilian pistachio paste finished with a ribbon of raw honeycomb.

signature.name: Cookies & Cream
signature.description: House-baked charcoal biscuit crumbled through Madagascan vanilla.

signature.name: Espresso Martini
signature.description: A double shot of cold-pressed espresso with coffee-liqueur notes, frozen mid-swirl.

signature.name: Matcha White Chocolate
signature.description: Ceremonial-grade matcha balanced against slow-melted white chocolate.

seasonal.name: Mango Sorbet
seasonal.description: Kensington Pride mangoes at their peak — pressed, churned, nothing else.

seasonal.name: Blood Orange Sorbet
seasonal.description: Winter citrus juiced the morning we serve it, sharp and blush-red.

seasonal.name: Spiced Poached Pear
seasonal.description: Packham pears poached in chai spice, churned through brown-butter cream.

seasonal.name: Lemon Myrtle Cheesecake
seasonal.description: Native lemon myrtle, cultured cream and a torched biscuit crumb.

toppings.name: Cocoa Dust

intro.heading: We bring the bar. Your guests watch dessert being made.
intro.body: Celsius makes gelato with liquid nitrogen. Two of our chefs set up at your venue and freeze each batch live, in a cloud of fog.
intro.events: We cater corporate events and brand activations, product launches, gala dinners, weddings, private parties, festivals and premieres across Sydney.
